name: MUSDB18-HQ
description: A high-quality version of the MUSDB18 benchmark, providing stereo music mixtures and isolated vocals, drums, bass, and other stems for music source separation research.
citation: Rafii, Z., Liutkus, A., Fabian-Robert, S., Mimilakis, S. I., & Bittner, R. (2017). MUSDB18: a corpus for music separation. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.1117372
